info.title: Knowledge Base control-plane API
info.description: Create, list and delete knowledge bases and mint child MCP tokens with a REST API key (kbk_…). Content stays on MCP.

apiKey.description: A REST API key from Settings → API keys (kbk_…). MCP tokens are refused.

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED

get.summary: The presented API key: its reach, toggles and child ceilings

429.description: Rate limited; wait Retry-After seconds (a create names the limit and window)
